The most recent release in the results is Kubernetes 1.37, which the official docs list as released on August 26, 2026. Its patch 1.37.1 is scheduled for September 15, 2026, so the 1.37 line should have received at least one patch by now, though the results don't confirm that.

The results are mixed on dates. The official Kubernetes 1.37 page lists 1.37.0 as the latest patch release, released on 2026-08-26. A third-party tracker, versionlog.com, still showed 1.36.2 as the latest stable, released 11 Jun 2026, and its pre-release list was out of date too. Its figures appear to be a snapshot from before 1.37.0 shipped, so I'd rely on the official page.

For context, the 1.36 line is still supported. The 1.36 docs page shows 1.36.2 as the latest patch release, with maintenance mode starting 2027-04-28. The official release-status page is the authoritative source if you need exact current patch numbers.

content.text:
The latest minor release is **Kubernetes 1.37 ("Garhwal")**, released on 2026-08-26. The official release page lists 1.37.0 as the latest patch.

- **Patch status:** A 1.37.1 patch was scheduled for 2026-09-15, so it has probably shipped by now. My search results didn't confirm that, so check the official page for the current patch number.
- **Previous line:** 1.36 is still supported, and its latest patch in the results was 1.36.2.
- **Conflicting source:** versionlog.com still showed 1.36.2 as the latest stable. It looks like an outdated snapshot, so I went with the official page.

Sources:
- [Kubernetes 1.37: Garhwal](https://kubernetes.io/releases/1.37/)
- [Kubernetes releases (kubernetes.io)](https://kubernetes.io/de/releases/_print/)
- [versionlog.com Kubernetes](https://versionlog.com/kubernetes/)
